info.title: Geoapify Postcode API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for Geoapify postcode search and autocomplete endpoints.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

get.description:
Searches for postcode features by postcode text or geographic coordinates.

- Provide `postcode`, or provide both `lat` and `lon`.
- Do not combine `postcode` with coordinate search.
- Use `geometry=point` for a point representation or `geometry=original` for source geometry.

**Example:** `postcode=10117`

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Postcode text to search. Mutually exclusive with lat/lon coordinate search.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for reverse postcode search. Must be used together with lon and without postcode.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude for reverse postcode search. Must be used together with lat and without postcode.

parameters.name: countrycode
parameters.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filter.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Result language as a supported two-letter language code.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Postcode geometry representation. Use point for centroid geometry or original for source geometry.

200.description: Postcode search result in the requested format.

400.description: Missing or invalid postcode search parameters.

example.message: "value" must contain at least one of [postcode, lat]

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

get.description:
Lists postcode features using optional text, spatial, and country constraints.

- `filter` restricts which results are returned.
- `bias` influences result order without excluding matches.
- Use `limit` and `offset` to paginate results.
- Use `geometry=point` for point representations or `geometry=original` for source geometry.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional spatial or place filter. Supported values include rect:lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2, circle:lon,lat,radius, and place:place_id. Multiple filters can be repeated or separated with |.

parameters.name: bias
parameters.description: Optional result bias. Supported values include proximity:lon,lat, circle:lon,lat,radius, and rect:lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2. Multiple bias values can be repeated or separated with |.

parameters.name: countrycode
parameters.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcode results to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matching results to skip.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Result language as a supported two-letter language code.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Postcode geometry representation. Use point for centroid geometry or original for source geometry.

200.description: Postcode list result in the requested format.

example.message: "limit" must be less than or equal to 500

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the gateway.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
